jax_copy.title: Road Traffic (Amendment) (Jax’s Law) Bill 2026
jax_copy.what: There has been a movement, advocating for change to the law in this area so that the loss of a pregnancy, as a result of careless or dangerous driving, would also allow the Director of Public Prosecutions to prosecute on indictment and to give a wider jurisdiction to the sentencing judge.
jax_copy.practical: The Bill will primarily do three things: 1.
jax_copy.context: Currently, the law deems careless and dangerous driving to be minor offences, to be prosecuted summarily (in the District Court) with limited penalties: a fine only in the case of careless driving; and a maximum sentence of 6 months in jail and/or a fine in the case of dangerous driving.
jax_copy.issues: Second Stage can test the Bill’s overall approach, including scope and definitions, implementation, oversight, and enforcement.
